- Shifting bias with new information much quicker. No ego, no care that I thought the opposite thing or said something different last week
- Gut first decision making. Brain will try and find all the reasons why it’s a bad idea, but gut has the higher win rate

- Reducing number of assets I’m following. Less is more. Decision fatigue is real.

- Not overtrading potential cycle winners for measly bear market profit (this doesn't include random onchain stuff that has a very small % chance of sustaining). 
- Alts that return to a HTF range that it broke out of is a major red flag in a bull, and should be cut majority of the time unless supreme conviction exists
- Being aware of high pivot point macro moments, but ignoring macro outside of that
